investment_strategy: Tilt to durable A.I. secular winners with a core-plus-satellite approach. Overweight a lower-volatility, cash-generative platform leader (MSFT) to anchor risk; pair with a high-momentum platform beneficiary (GOOGL) for growth; add a capped allocation to the AI compute leader (NVDA) to capture infrastructure upside. Macro supports a moderately bullish stance (low VIX ~16.7, stable 10Y ~3.8%, positive index trend). Size positions to reflect elevated valuations, regulatory overhang (Alphabet), and semis cyclicality/export controls (NVIDIA). Rebalance quarterly or if VIX > 25 or 10Y > 4.5%. 12–24 month horizon.

portfolio_summary.strategy_focus: A.I.-driven secular growth via platform leaders and compute, anchored by lower-volatility software/cloud exposure

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Prioritized lower volatility, strong fundamental growth, positive momentum, and strong analyst consensus; incorporated news on A.I. capex, regulatory risk, and supply constraints; sized allocations based on macro (low VIX, stable rates) and company-specific risk.
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Moderately bullish: A.I. demand remains robust with supportive macro (low volatility, steady yields). Key risks include antitrust actions, A.I. governance shifts, export controls, power/data center bottlenecks, and capex digestion; portfolio weights reflect these.
